topic: Counting Little Ants on a Leaf
description: Chintu aur Mithu ke saath milkar pyaari cheentiyon ko ginna seekhein. Yeh bachon ke liye ek mazedaar counting gaana hai.
learning: Learning to count numbers 1 to 10 in both Hindi and English.
